open.statement: Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D066-PAIRS: The claim that none of 39 pairs beats face density was not re-derived. This review did not run the owner's model.
Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D066-MODULUS-CAPS: The modulus closures, the Q 0.82 payload of about -40 t, and the gamma-cap payloads were not re-optimized on the independent route.

Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D066-OPTIMISTIC: Optimistic and ISA lifts are the same number. COMMON states one pressure and one density. The stress difference between the weathers is not in that brief.
Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D066-VC: Reported Vc is 1.291 to 1.323, below 2, so the handbook step stays 0.20 if that rule is granted. The Vc formula is not in COMMON and was not recomputed.

Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D066-ABOVE-BILL: Mass above faces, core and joining is 1404 kg at concept R 20 ISA and 3868 kg at concept R 30 ISA. Joining exceeds the two film sheets. COMMON's 5 percent joints plus 100 kg does not recover the split.
Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D066-SHARED-MODEL: The payload match to DELTA-C within 0.0021 kg is a comparison of two outputs of the same model. It is not an independent derivation.

Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D-UNOPENED-SOURCES: This round did not re-open the Toray M60J sheet, DOI 10.1021/acsanm.3c01282, the textbook pages that print 3820 and 3530, the AlBeMet sheet, the 3M AF 163-2 table, or the SAE extract. Index arithmetic from the stated inputs reproduces. Those inputs are unchecked.

Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D-SAE-YIELD: 066 measured a face-strength slope of zero at 345 MPa because yield is not binding there. The SAE minimum is 206.8 MPa. Whether that floor stays off the bind was not run. This review does not run the hull model.

Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D-DIAMOND-BOOKLET: The filed 100 mm diameter is not on the mechanical page. The disks page checked today says up to 120 mm. The CVD booklet named in 067 was not opened, so a 100 mm line in that booklet is unchecked.

Carried, not demonstrated again. NFI-D-BLEND-IS-LOCAL: Density over modulus to the power 0.514 is the local slope ratio at concept R 30 ISA. It is not a re-optimized hull clear. The linear modulus factor matching a density factor of 1.743 would be about 2.95, while 066's measured concept-ISA closure was near 2.09 to 2.12 and concept optimistic did not close on modulus.

Sciences admitted 066 conditionally, and no 067 admission has been filed. Density-only is the best mix found under the stated L1 norm and the tested pairs, not a proven global minimum. PROBE corrects RUN's modulus-failure labels. Bracket artifacts are not mix improvements, and optimizer nulls do not prove physical impossibility. The direct-Python follow-ups are an execution exception kept apart from numerical status.

Carried apart from numerical status. The pair probe, the modulus closure, the face slopes already in RESULTS.json, and DERIV.json ran as direct python on the pinned copy, one core, after the kept simjob. The kept search is simjob-20261020t175116-2cf59f790fe1, exit 0, 112 s.

The 040 case source string names pinned 014b and pinned 016 for the block that holds the 1.01 pressure floor. 014b is not in the model's SOURCE-INDEX and was not opened. COMMON.md states neither the 1.01 floor nor the wind formula. The pressure-augmentation recompute is the consequence of that open pin, not a finding that the floor is false.
